description: Source code for media understanding runner entries, including functions for processing media via CLI and provider-based methods, handling different media types (image, audio, video), and managing provider configurations and execution context.

methods.name: sanitizeProviderHeaders
methods.description: Sanitizes provider headers by filtering out non-string values.

methods.name: trimOutput
methods.description: Trims output text to a maximum number of characters.

methods.name: extractSherpaOnnxText
methods.description: Extracts text from Sherpa ONNX raw output.

methods.name: commandBase
methods.description: Gets the base name of a command path.

methods.name: findArgValue
methods.description: Finds the value of a command-line argument given a list of keys.

methods.name: hasArg
methods.description: Checks if any of the specified keys are present in the argument list.

methods.name: resolveWhisperOutputPath
methods.description: Resolves the output path for Whisper CLI based on arguments.

methods.name: resolveWhisperCppOutputPath
methods.description: Resolves output path for Whisper C++.

methods.name: resolveParakeetOutputPath
methods.description: Resolves output path for Parakeet MLX.

methods.name: resolveCliOutput
methods.description: Resolves the CLI command output, reading from file or extracting from stdout.

methods.name: resolveCliMediaPath
methods.description: Resolves media path for CLI commands, converting to WAV if necessary.

methods.name: normalizeProviderQuery
methods.description: Normalizes provider query options into a consistent format.

methods.name: buildDeepgramCompatQuery
methods.description: Builds Deepgram-specific query parameters.

methods.name: normalizeDeepgramQueryKeys
methods.description: Normalizes Deepgram query keys to consistent naming.

methods.name: resolveProviderQuery
methods.description: Builds provider query parameters based on config and entry options.

methods.name: buildModelDecision
methods.description: Constructs a model decision object based on entry and outcome.

methods.name: resolveEntryRunOptions
methods.description: Resolves max bytes, chars, timeout, and prompt for media processing.

methods.name: resolveProviderExecutionAuth
methods.description: Resolves API keys and provider config for execution.

methods.name: resolveProviderExecutionContext
methods.description: Builds execution context including API keys, base URL, headers, and request overrides.

methods.name: formatDecisionSummary

methods.name: runCliEntry
